method: Actual Codex in-app browser, production-built local frontend, direct hosted Neon Fetch requests; DOM/accessibility observations and screenshots retained in task

checks.name: error retry and explicit first-page recovery
controlled client clock expiry
checks.note: Only browser bootstrap lifetime shortened to 20 seconds; actual hosted reads, no server clock change

checks.name: actual hosted expired token
checks.note: Deliberately already-expired server test seed; real hosted 401, not mocked API

checks.name: happy-path console observation
checks.note: Expected invalid-cursor and expiry states tested separately; initial rollout mismatch recorded in report

performanceSample.scope: 19 retained unique request observations across selected browser checkpoints; not total task traffic. Includes two deliberate 400 cursor failures. Server CORS preflights and static assets are not counted by this Fetch instrumentation.
performanceSample.heapMeaning: Browser-reported approximate used JS heap at request completion across reloads. Not isolated component retention, forced-GC, leak, saturation, cold-start or SLA evidence.

credentialStorageEvidence: Bootstrap removed in actual DOM; memory-only client and no storage/URL writes are verified by source/transport tests. No browser-storage contents are copied into evidence.
limitations: Operator-launched loopback development session, not production user login or tenant onboarding
Representative manual browser path plus deterministic/API negative regressions, not an exhaustive browser fuzz/load test
Screenshots remain reviewable in the task; compact committed observations are not a screenshot archive
